<!-- Generated by `make docs-gen` from the code. Do not edit: change the code and regenerate. -->

Sends items to a web address: a message to a Discord or Slack channel, or the items as JSON to any service that takes them.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `output.webhook` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Webhook URL (`url`) | text | yes |  | From the channel's integration settings in Discord or Slack. Personal: sharing the workflow leaves it out. |
| Message (`message`) | text | no | `Update from your Polythought workflow` | {{field}} puts in an item's field, e.g. {{question}} or {{spread}}. |
| Send (`send`) | text | no | `all` | all: one request listing every item. each: one request per item, up to 20 a run. One of `all`, `each`. |
| Format (`format`) | text | no | `message` | message: the text above, for chat apps. json: the items themselves. One of `message`, `json`. |
| Credential (`credential`) | one of your credentials: [HTTP header](/docs/reference/credential-types/#http-header) | no |  | Optional. A header sent with each request, such as Authorization, from your Credentials page. Personal: sharing the workflow leaves it out. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on as they are.
